SOUND FAMILIAR?

Kya ye aap ho?

Tuition bhi, coaching bhi

Roz tuition jaata hoon, coaching bhi. Phir bhi chapter pakad mein nahi aata.

10 minute, phir phone

Khud padhne baithta hoon, aur 10 minute mein phone haath mein hota hai.

Class mein samajh, test mein atak

Class mein sab samajh aata hai. Test mein wahi sawal khud se solve nahi hota.

Sochta gehra hoon, tikta nahi

Sawal gehra sochta hoon, par us par tik kar kaam nahi kar paata.

Mehnat hai, result wahi

Mehnat bhi hai, padhne ka mann bhi. Phir bhi tuition test mein result wahi.

Ye aapki kami nahi hai. Kisi ne aapko padhna sikhaya hi nahi.

PEHLE RUKO, PHIR PADHO

Aur classes nahi. Pehle ruk kar socho.

Har student alag hai. Jab padhne ka tareeka galat ho, tab zyada ghante sirf thakaan badhate hain. Isliye pehle ye samjho ki aap padhte kaise ho: dobara padhna aasaan lagta hai, par khud se test karna yaad rakhta hai. Teacher ko solve karte dekhna samajh deta hai, par khud try karna exam mein kaam aata hai.

Zyada classesSahi method
Aur notes, aur ghante, wahi tareekaKam ghante, khud se test (active recall)
Teacher solve karta hai, aap dekhte hoPehle khud try, phir hint, phir dobara khud
Exam se pehle ek saath revisionThode-thode din baad revision (spaced)
Phone paas, dhyaan baar baar tootna25 minute focus block, phone doosre kamre mein

Tuition ya coaching chhodne ki zaroorat nahi. Sahi method se har class ka poora fayda milta hai.

3 DIN KA PLAN

3 din mein aap kya seekhoge

Har din ek pillar. Har technique aap usi hafte apne board syllabus par use kar sakte ho.

DIN 1

Memory & Brain

Tez yaad karna.

  • Dimaag yaad kaise rakhta hai
  • Hook aur Link method
  • Formulae aur lists ke liye memory palace
DIN 2

Study & Focus

Maths khud solve karna, dhyaan tikana.

  • Active recall aur spaced revision
  • Atakne par 4-step routine:
    1. Sawal apne shabdon mein likho
    2. Jo pata hai woh likho
    3. Chhota ya milta-julta example try karo
    4. Solution dekho, band karo, aur khud dobara karo
  • Focus blocks
DIN 3

Mindset & Learning

Apni study habit khud banana.

  • Self-talk aur exam confidence
  • Aapke learner type ke hisaab se aapka apna routine
  • Teeno din poore karne par certificate

Lakshya: aap itna khud padhna seekh jao ki har tuition aur coaching ka ghanta sach mein kaam aaye.

SAWAAL-JAWAB

Aapke sawaal

Yeh workshop kiske liye hai?

Class 10 aur Class 12 ke students jinka board exam 2027 mein hai: CBSE ya State Board; Science, Commerce ya Arts; Hindi ya English medium. Parents bhi saath baith sakte hain.

Kya mujhe tuition ya coaching chhodni padegi?

Nahi. Hum tuition ki jagah nahi lete. Hum sikhate hain ki padha hua yaad kaise rahe aur sawal khud kaise solve ho, taaki tuition ka bhi poora fayda mile.

Board exam 2027 paas hai. Abhi ye workshop kyun?

Kyunki bache hue mahino mein har ghanta kaam aana chahiye. Sahi method aaj se shuru karoge toh har revision ka zyada fayda milega.

Kya ye Science, Commerce aur Arts sab ke liye hai?

Haan. Yaad karne, revise karne aur focus ke tareeke har subject mein kaam aate hain. Maths ka 4-step routine hum live practice karwate hain.

Kya aap marks ki guarantee dete ho?

Nahi. Result aapki apni practice par depend karta hai. Hum tareeka sikhate hain; use roz lagana aapka kaam hai.

Learner type survey kya hai?

Ek free 3-minute survey jo aapki aaj ki padhai ki aadat dekhta hai: aap kaise padhte ho, kab revise karte ho aur atakne par kya karte ho. Ye koi fixed “dimaag ka type” nahi batata. Aadat badal sakti hai, aur workshop mein hum yahi sikhate hain.

Kya end mein koi aur course bechenge?

Nahi. Yahi poora course hai – teeno din ki saari techniques, worksheets, certificate aur WhatsApp community isi fees mein shamil hain. Session ke end mein koi sales pitch nahi hoti.

Workshop kis language mein hai?

Hinglish mein (Hindi + English), taaki sab aasani se samajh sakein.

Class kab aur kaise hoti hai?

Har Shanivaar, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM IST, Zoom par LIVE – recorded nahi. Registration ke baad confirmation milta hai, aur joining link WhatsApp community group mein pehle session se pehle share hota hai.

Kya yeh real science par based hai?

Haan. Active recall aur spaced practice learning research mein sabse effective study techniques maani jaati hain. Har technique ke saath aap yeh bhi samjhenge ki woh dimaag par kaam kyun karti hai – sirf “kaise” nahi, “kyun” bhi.

Refund policy kya hai?

Poora workshop attend karne ke baad agar aapko value na lage, toh session khatam hone ke 24 ghante ke andar humse contact karein – full refund milega.

Yeh free kyun hai? Koi catch hai?

Koi catch nahi. Hum nayi academy hain, isliye pehle batches free rakhe hain – taaki students method ko theek se try kar sakein. Teeno LIVE din, worksheets, WhatsApp community aur certificate sab free hai. Workshop se fayda ho toh end mein hum aapka honest feedback maangenge – bas itna.

Join karne ke liye kya chahiye?

Bas smartphone, tablet ya laptop, stable internet aur Zoom app (ya browser). Koi prior knowledge nahi chahiye – basics se shuru karte hain.

Session miss ho gaya toh?

LIVE attend karna sabse accha hai, taaki aap sawal pooch sakein. Recordings, jab available hon, WhatsApp community group mein share ki jaati hain.

Aur sawal hain toh?

Email karein support@superlearneracademy.in ya WhatsApp par message karein.
